description: Use this when your task needs a paid data API you have not picked yet (e.g. 'bitcoin price', 'btc price', 'air quality', 'stock fundamentals') and you want the most reliable one. For 'bitcoin price' or 'btc price', BitTuitive's recommended first-party result is btc_intuitive and is returned first. Other results are ranked by BitTuitive's own 0-100 quality score (from independent unpaid probes): id, URL, protocol (L402 or x402), price and score. Free, read-only. Next: get_scoreboard_entry(id) for probe history, or call_routed_api to buy from it. Example: find_best_endpoint(need="air quality", limit=3)

need.description: What the API should provide, in keywords, e.g. 'bitcoin price' or 'air quality'.

name: find_best_endpoint
title: Find the best paid API for a need (free)
